page.layout: One page of text in a single column of verse, with a printed ornament below it. Below the verse, a line "I. I. B." set right. In the right margin, beside the lower verse, the single word "IN". Running head at top, page number at top left. Ornament woodcut below the text, not text.

main_text.p: Si subiecta Scotis regna ferocibus, Quaris, si mutilis navibus Orcades Ter denas, celebres naufragiis, venis,
Si Sulcas mare Hibernicum, Sunt haec cuncta tuis littora puppibus Infesta hic rapidis vorticibus mare Infidum, scopulis atque Aquilonibus Raucum perpetuis vides.
Tandem mobilibus ludibrium diu Venis facta, vagis atque laboribus, Debellata cades immiserabilis, Hispano procul aequore.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a woodcut (a grotesque mask with foliage and drops), not text. Several letters in the verse are set in italic type; the page is printed in a roman with italic verse, rendered here without <i> tags for legibility. Possible misreadings: "Infesta" (first letters faint), "Infidum", "Hispano". The word "IN" in the right margin is a large capital, read as printed, and may be a catchword or the start of the next text; its position is uncertain. Show-through text from the reverse side is visible on the right and is not transcribed.
